# S5.4 — M1 designed ablation, live debt, provider-drift compatibility and R2 reproduction (§5h.6, §5h.7, §5h.8, §8.3)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.3` (PR #85) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the M1 attribution seam, the live half of the
assumption-debt manager, the provider-drift compatibility
path and the R2 reproduction gates — under the
`offline-only` budget (`R-2.9.7²`, `R-2.9.6¹`,
`R-2.9.8¹`, `R-2.9.3²`, `R-2.12.1²`).

**M1 designed ablation** (`hh-analysis`; R-2.9.7² —
AC-R-2.9.7-4/-10/-11/-13): `component_targets`
enumerates a sealed definition's typed ablation
coordinates — `slot`, `variant`, `rule`, `parameter`,
`procedure`, `text_leaf` (the spec's `leaf` canonicalizes
to it), `decision_point` — under a 64-target cap with
kind/substring filters; `attribution_design` desugars to
`hh-attribution-design/1`. The kernel gains
`estimand ∈ {designed_ablation, loo, loi}`,
`recipe ∈ {designed_ablation, retirement}` (the
retirement recipe adds `removal_verdict ∈ {pass, fail,
inconclusive}`), `budget.regime ∈ {uniform,
concentrated}` + `budget_allocation_ref`, and
`multiplicity{n_tests, correction}`; `report_id` is the
content address of the report-minus-id so a re-run over
the same design/watermark/seed reproduces it (KA-I7-11).
A uniform allocation below a target's search floor emits
null effects named `below_search_floor` — the target
stays in the report, never silently dropped (KA-I7-4).
Hosted rows render `n/a{class}` except the one admissible
triple — `observation_substitution` ∩ `model_io`
interception ∩ configuration granularity (KA-I7-10);
`UnmatchedBudget` still refuses arms outside the matched
configuration-level Δ at the experiment boundary
(AC-R-2.9.7-13).

**Live assumption debt** (`hh-lab::debt`; R-2.9.6¹ —
AC-R-2.9.6-10): `evaluate_debt` folds the §05b
observable legs through `hh-compiler`'s newly public
`evaluate_debt_record` and merges the manager-level
triggers — `profile_change` (kind ⇢ cause),
`evidence_supersession`, `probation_overrun` — into one
`StatusTransition` list (hard subsumes warn; causes
sorted+deduplicated). `debt_index` folds stored status +
transition history into `DebtIndexRow`s carrying
`debt_class`/`deficiency_class`/`evidence_grade`/
`stored_status`/`last_trigger`/`removal_test_state`/
`used_by`/`expired_used_runs`/`staleness_reasons`;
`AssumptionDebtHealth::report` buckets expired-used /
expiring / open / not-yet-testable rows and mints
`DebtNotice`s routed by owner reachability ∩
policy-declared sinks (unreachable → `"unrouted"`).

**Provider-drift compatibility** (`hh-lab::model`;
R-2.9.8¹ — AC-R-2.9.8-5/-10): `run_regression_suite`
folds a `HarnessRegressionSuite` to
`verified`/`drifted{rules[]}`/`broken{evidence_ref}`/
`unknown` (drift-first precedence; `drifted` names the
moved rules sorted+deduped). `synthetic_snapshot_claim`
mints the DRIFT-path claim — `snapshot_id =
drift:<drift_ref>`, no weights digest, unknown policy
exposure/cutoff, no serving route — honest unknowns,
never fabricated. `guard_at_bind(None)` refuses
`UnpinnedSnapshot`. `regression_drifted_rules` is the
`drifted ⇒ expiring` bridge into `evaluate_debt` — a
`broken` suite expires nothing it cannot attribute.

**R2 reproduction gates** (`hh-bundle`; R-2.12.1²):
`AssembleInputs`/`CompileOutcome` gain `profile_refs[]`
and `images[]`; `resolved_dependencies` carries both;
`levels::derive` emits `B-R2-profile` (every profile ref
`pinned: true`) and `B-R2-images` (every image carries a
string `digest`). Empty members satisfy; a missing pin
lowers the reproduction basis with the gap named.

**Surfaces** (CC4/CC5): Group L ops
`lab.debt.{evaluate,index,report}`,
`lab.model.{snapshot_claim,regression}`,
`lab.analysis.{component_targets,attribution_design}` —
records-in/records-out over `hh-embed/1`, embed fold
byte-identical to the in-process `debt_index` fold
(asserted). Schema + generated client regenerated from
the single source. `hh-cli` lab nouns and `hh-web` V10
supervision consume `measurement.debt.*` /
`lifecycle.debt.*` / `lab.debt.report`. `hh-eval`
catalogue gains `attribution_quality` + the `debt.*`
health set (native-only — hosted arms render
`n/a{class}`).

**Requirement IDs:** R-2.9.7², R-2.9.6¹, R-2.9.8¹,
R-2.9.3², R-2.12.1²
**Gating ACs:** AC-R-2.9.6-10 · AC-R-2.9.7-{4,10–11,13} ·
AC-R-2.9.8-{5,10} · covers KA-I7-4, KA-I7-10, KA-I7-11
